rule_hit_review.why: A time or duration is stated exactly as the product page states it, with the study basis in the footnote; keep verbatim, brand/legal decide.

tone_read: Calm, declarative and educational in Minimalist's voice; no fear, hype or emoji.
language_read: The figure and its wording match the product page and the basis sits in the footnote; no absolute or unhedged efficacy wording.
